comparison.objective: Lift, spread, and refit a delta robot's sprung parallel-rod pair by clipping four cups onto ball studs; candidate commissions an installed axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests bimanual spring spreading, four-way socket-to-ball alignment, snap-on capture, and controlled release without dropping or overstretching. Candidate tests counterheld unlocking, hex-bit withdrawal/re-engagement, fine collar adjustment, relocking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires release with four cups within 2.5 mm of their ball centers, no spacing ≥92 mm or drop, and 1 s stability. Candidate requires two safe repeatable impacts within published energy, velocity, and stroke limits, plus lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot maintenance and bimanual force control, but the record tests multi-point sprung snap assembly while the candidate tests adjustment and empirical validation of dissipative behavior. Industrial domain alone does not establish overlap.
